content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the RITES Individual Consultant recruitment is 11 October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the RITES Individual Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include a Diploma in Electrical/ Electronics Engineering, Diploma in Civil Engineering, or Diploma in Electronics and Communication/Electronics/Electrical Engineering, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the RITES Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Individual Consultant posts in RITES recruitment is 63 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for any category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the RITES Individual Consultant roles?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 55,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- per month, with specific amounts varying for each consultant role as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Individual Consultant posts at RITES?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Individual Consultant positions, with one vacancy for each of the three specified roles.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for the RITES Individual Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the RITES Individual Consultant recruitment is strictly online. Candidates must apply through the official RITES website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for RITES Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the RITES Individual Consultant recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the RITES Individual Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the RITES Individual Consultant positions involves two main stages: Document Scrutiny followed by an Interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What are the important dates for the RITES Individual Consultant application?
faq.answer: The online application starts on 22 September 2026 and the last date to apply is 11 October 2026. Interviews are scheduled for 15 and 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official RITES recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official RITES recruitment notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
